name: 1001 Nights
description: 1001 Nights features Shahrzad, a storyteller, in a Persian court with her sister Donyazad, King Shahryar, Prince Shahzaman and a playful monkey named Maymoon.

videos.title: The Joke's on You
videos.overview: A mischievous boy thinks it’s funny to play practical jokes until he gets his family lost in the woods. As things go from bad to worse, he realizes he may have played one prank too many.

videos.title: King Bitehard
videos.overview: A young prince who is sensitive about his big teeth learns a valuable lesson on how to treat others.

videos.title: Sinbad and the Valley of the Serpents
videos.overview: Sinbad and his trusty sidekick, Dina, enjoy a wacky adventure as they pursue wealth and riches in the fearsome Valley of the Serpents.

videos.title: Manjab's Just Desserts
videos.overview: A young boy works in a bakery and begins to steal the merchandise. It’s the perfect crime until he can no longer hide the evidence.

videos.title: Princess Rou
videos.overview: A not-so-attractive princess must choose between suitors who want to marry her for her money, so she demands they defeat her in the wrestling ring first.

videos.title: What's Yours is Mine
videos.overview: A fisherman refuses to sell a pearl given to him by a mermaid. Unfortunately, the emperor is determined to have it.

videos.title: True Treasure
videos.overview: A man has a dream that riches wait for him inside a palace. He follows his dream only to find that his true treasure was something entirely different.

videos.title: Sinbad and the Cyclops
videos.overview: Sinbad and Dina are once again off on a wild adventure that takes them to the far off island of the Cyclops.

videos.title: Hunchback's Tale
videos.overview: Everyone thinks they were responsible for the death of a poor hunchback. The truth is far stranger than they imagined.

videos.title: Agrabroka
videos.overview: A bag of gold makes its way through an entire town and changes the lives of everyone there.

videos.title: Give Until It Hurts
videos.overview: A poor man inherits a large sum of money and is surprised to see all the new friends he suddenly has. In the end, he learns what true friendship means.

videos.title: Ali Baba & The 40 Thieves
videos.overview: Ali Baba’s town is robbed by the famed forty thieves. When he follows their trail, Ali finds their hidden cave, filled with stolen treasure. He takes it back, but he incurs the wrath of their leader, Tabnak the Terrible.

videos.title: Keeping Up With The Jinns
videos.overview: A man stumbles across a bottle and a lamp in the middle of the desert. When he opens them, two genies appear who hate each other.

videos.title: King For a Day
videos.overview: A man brags that he could run things better if he were in charge. He gets his chance.

videos.title: Abu Sabir
videos.overview: When everyone in town goes running off to find treasure, the ever patient Abu Sabir refuses to participate.

videos.title: Bigger, Badder, Badr
videos.overview: A lone man stands up to an evil tyrant and incurs his wrath.

videos.title: The Boy Who Cried Science
videos.overview: A young boy is forced to deal with ignorance and fear when superstition takes over his town.

videos.title: Prince Ahmad
videos.overview: A young prince is commanded to lead his country into battle and learns what it takes to be a great king.

videos.title: It's a Steal
videos.overview: A suspicious looking man is accused of stealing from his neighbors. The townspeople learn that things are not always what they seem.

videos.title: Which Way Is Up?
videos.overview: A family goes in search of a better life but they descend into bickering and hatred when they can’t agree on the right path to take. In the end, they learn there is more than one way up the mountain.

videos.title: To Hatch a Thief
videos.overview: When ordinary townspeople resort to stealing, they soon learn what it’s like to have to live among thieves.

videos.title: The Gift of Norooz
videos.overview: A poor family learns the true spirit of giving during the Persian New Year.

videos.title: Creature Karma
videos.overview: A young girl befriends three animals who lead her on an interesting journey.

videos.title: Just My Luck
videos.overview: An unlucky man just can't get a break.

videos.title: Details, Details...
videos.overview: A loose bolt on a wagon wheel sets in motion a chain of events that ends up destroying an entire town.

videos.title: Sinbad in Solitude
videos.overview: A shipwrecked Sinbad and Dina embark on an hilarious voyage that takes them to the exotic island of the Wok Wok women.

videos.title: The Tale of Taymour and Tiny
videos.overview: Taymour accidentally knocks an egg out of a bird’s nest and decides to care for it. When he does, he gets a big surprise.

videos.title: The Boy and the Panther
videos.overview: Nadeem witnesses a crime at the fair and sees that the wrong person gets blamed. Since he wasn’t supposed to be there, he can’t tell anyone or he’ll get in trouble.

videos.title: Abu Kassim’s Smelly Shoes
videos.overview: A grouchy old man inherits a pair of smelly shoes. No matter how hard he tries, he is unable to get rid of them.

videos.title: The Bandits of Basra
videos.overview: Mujab and Sameer pretend to be lawmen in order to land jobs as sheriffs in a small town. What they don’t realize is that they have to arrest the most vicious bandit in the territory.

videos.title: The Genie, the Fish, the Wolf and the Witch
videos.overview: When Shahryar can’t sleep, Shahrzad tells a series of stories within stories that become fascinatingly intertwined.

videos.title: The Forbidden City of Shenzhen
videos.overview: Ahn-Ming climbs to the other side of the forbidden wall to learn that everything he’s been taught about his evil neighbors is wrong.

videos.title: The Broken Jewel
videos.overview: Two servants accidentally break a jewel from the king’s crown. In order to avoid getting caught, they must find another one at the top of Asir Mountain.

videos.title: The Boy Who Became a Genie
videos.overview: Dissatisfied with his life, Harif trades places with a genie, only to discover that his boring life wasn’t so bad after all.

videos.title: The Tale of the Mountain and the Valley
videos.overview: A silly rumor spreads like wildfire through two communities, causing them to go to war with each other.

videos.title: Three Tales of a Daydreaming Boy
videos.overview: A set of three shorts about two artists who compete for the same customers, a thirsty bird who struggles to drink the water at the bottom of a bottle, and two kids who accidentally release a mischievous genie.

videos.title: The Riddle of the Ruined Tomb
videos.overview: Three witnesses to a crime each give different accounts about what really happened.

videos.title: The Merchant and the Pickpocket
videos.overview: A young pickpocket learns that there is no honor among thieves.

videos.title: Arman the Cheat
videos.overview: When a young boy gets away with cheating, he decides that crime really does pay.

videos.title: Abu Hassan’s Legendary Wedding
videos.overview: A wedding goes horribly wrong when the groom appears to have uncontrollable flatulence.

videos.title: The King Who Became a Slave
videos.overview: A king learns what happens when he’s out of touch with his people.

videos.title: The Spoon That Ruined Everything
videos.overview: People in a small community see a spoon for the first time and begin to fight over it.

videos.title: The King Who Outlawed Laughter
videos.overview: A king tries to execute his prisoners but no matter what he does, he is unable to kill them.

videos.title: Sinbad and the Black Diamond
videos.overview: Sinbad is off once more on a hilarious adventure. This time he battles the dread pirate Santiago for a mysterious black diamond that possesses strange powers.

videos.title: The Man Who Went Back in Time
videos.overview: A man complains his life would have been better if he’d been given his neighbour’s lucky breaks. When he gets the chance to go back in time and change things, however, he realizes it’s not as easy as he imagined.

videos.title: The Schoolmaster
videos.overview: A con man lies his way into a job as a Schoolmaster and learns an unexpected lesson about the value of integrity.

videos.title: The Tale of the Haunted Palace
videos.overview: When their wagon breaks down in the middle of nowhere, Shahryar, Shahrzad, Shahzaman, and Donyazad are forced to spend the night in a haunted palace.

videos.title: Habib and the Baby Genie
videos.overview: A baby genie and a human genie are switched at birth.

videos.title: Three Tales of a Daydreaming Girl
videos.overview: A second set of shorts about a cat who befriends a bird, a genie-in-training, and a little pickpocket who finds kindness in others.

videos.title: Abu Mohammad Lazybones
videos.overview: A simpleton rises to become the leader of a town without trying to.

videos.title: Sinbad Forever
videos.overview: When Sinbad destroys the Queen’s fleet, he gets stripped of his rank and becomes homeless.

videos.title: One Thousand and One Nights
videos.overview: The story of how the book of 1001 Nights came to be.
